decisions.reason: As a software extension of the firm's oncology QA core, it still offers learning and cross-selling value, and the cost of keeping the option open remains modest.
This CT image quality phantom is close to the firm's established imaging QA capabilities and is likely inexpensive to keep on offer while demand becomes clearer.
Although mammography is more distant from the core, the product is still very new and management would usually preserve this adjacent option until more market evidence arrives.
This full field mammography phantom is an adjacent and somewhat narrower bet, so its withdrawal risk is higher, but it is still too early to foreclose the option outright.
As a flagship medical imaging QA instrument line aligned with the firm's stated direction, it has strong strategic fit and management would be reluctant to abandon it so early.
